method: Pair serialized wire observations and usage events by ordinal only when counts and temporal non-overlap agree. This is descriptive, without provider request-ID joins. Intervals include model/provider/network and SDK reporting delay; they do not identify reasoning compute alone. Sum of tool durations can overlap other tools/background commands and is not a wall-time partition. No imputation for unmatched sequences or missing final trial duration. Interrupted partial intervals are not complete-trial measurements.
